dogecoin.text: Dogecoin gave us the meme, but Dawgz AI is building something lasting. Are we witnessing the rise of a smarter dog?

SEC just delayed decisions on multiple XRP, SOLANA, LITECOIN, and DOGECOIN ETFs. The delay tactics keep coming, but the writing is on the wall. Crypto product approvals are inevitable—it’s just a matter of when, not if.
